option_relations.rationale: Eosinophilic annular erythema (EAE) is a broader category that includes immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced eosinophilic annular erythema as a specific type.
Wells syndrome is a distinct eosinophilic dermatosis with different clinical and histological features than the provided leaf.
Granuloma annulare is a distinct dermatological condition characterized by granulomatous inflammation, which is not described in the leaf.
Drug-induced erythema annulare centrifugum is a different annular erythema with distinct etiologies and histological findings compared to the leaf.
